facts.text: Surrounded by houses, the architect built an extra high yet short structure with tall windows.
facts.sourceQuote: Because the church is surrounded by houses, the architect chose to build an extra high, yet short building with high windows.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Because the church is surrounded by houses, the architect chose to build an extra high, yet short building with high windows.

facts.text: Monsignor Schaepman dedicated the building in 1877, though the interior remained unfinished until 1891.
facts.sourceQuote: The church was dedicated in 1877 by monsignor Schaepman, but the interior wasn't completed until 1891.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was dedicated in 1877 by monsignor Schaepman, but the interior wasn't completed until 1891.

facts.text: A well-known organ built by Maarschalkerweerd resides within the Sint-Willibrordkerk.
facts.sourceQuote: The church has a well known organ built by Maarschalkerweerd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church has a well known organ built by Maarschalkerweerd.

facts.text: The Sint-Willibrordkerk received rijksmonument status in 1976.
facts.sourceQuote: It is at Minrebroederstraat 21, Utrecht, in the Netherlands and has been designated a rijksmonument since 1976.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It is at Minrebroederstraat 21, Utrecht, in the Netherlands and has been designated a rijksmonument since 1976.

facts.text: The traditionalist Society of Saint Pius X operates this Roman Catholic church.
facts.sourceQuote: St Willibrord's Church, Utrecht, is a Roman Catholic church operated by the traditionalist Society of Saint Pius X (SSPX) and dedicated to Saint Willibrord.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: St Willibrord's Church, Utrecht, is a Roman Catholic church operated by the traditionalist Society of Saint Pius X (SSPX) and dedicated to Saint Willibrord.

facts.text: Since 2022, the site has operated as a restaurant and event venue.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2022 heeft het fort een publieksfunctie en is het in gebruik als restaurant en evenementen locatie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2022, the fort has had a public function and is in use as a restaurant and event venue.

facts.text: Fort Ruigenhoek lies east of it as part of the New Holland Water Line's third phase.
facts.sourceQuote: Ten oosten van het fort ligt Fort Ruigenhoek dat in de derde bouwfase van de Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie is gerealiseerd
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: East of the fort lies Fort Ruigenhoek, which was realized in the third construction phase of the New Holland Water Line.

facts.text: VVJ takes its name from the Utrecht Machinefabriek Jaffa factory.
facts.sourceQuote: De club is genoemd naar de Utrechtse Machinefabriek Jaffa.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The club is named after the Utrecht Machinefabriek Jaffa.

facts.text: The club was established in 1931 as an amateur football team.
facts.sourceQuote: Voetbalvereniging Jaffa, ook bekend als VVJ, is een Nederlandse amateurvoetbalclub uit de stad Utrecht, opgericht in 1931.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Voetbalvereniging Jaffa, also known as VVJ, is a Dutch amateur football club from the city of Utrecht, founded in 1931.

facts.text: Father Guillelmus Stas served as pastor here for nearly thirty years starting in 1815.
facts.sourceQuote: Bouwpastoor was in beide gevallen pater Guillelmus Stas (1771-1857), van 1815 tot 1843 aan de statie van de Augustijnen verbonden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In both cases, the building pastor was Father Guillelmus Stas (1771-1857), who was associated with the Augustinians' station from 1815 to 1843.

facts.text: A falling vault fragment forced a closure by fire fighters in 2016.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2016 werd het gebouw gesloten door de brandweer nadat een brokstuk uit het gewelf naar beneden was gekomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2016, the building was closed by the fire brigade after a fragment from the vault had fallen down.

facts.text: A temple front with enormous Doric columns crowns the canal side of this 40-meter high structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze valt op door het tempelfront met de enorme dorische zuilen aan de grachtzijde, bekroond door een fronton en een luchtig torentje (het geheel 40 m hoog).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It stands out due to the temple front with the enormous Doric columns on the canal side, crowned by a pediment and a light tower (the whole 40 m high).

facts.text: Prosper Venneman from Ghent crafted the main altar in 1857.
facts.sourceQuote: Het hoofdaltaar werd in 1857 vervaardigd door Prosper Venneman uit Gent.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The main altar was made in 1857 by Prosper Venneman from Ghent.

facts.text: A solar panel installation was rejected for the protected building, delaying redevelopment plans.
facts.sourceQuote: Door de coronacrisis en weigering van de bouwvergunning (met name vanwege het plaatsen van zonnepanelen op een gemeentelijk monument) heeft de herontwikkeling (te) lang op zich laten wachten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the corona crisis and refusal of the building permit (especially due to the installation of solar panels on a municipal monument), the redevelopment has been delayed (too) long.

facts.text: New stars are unveiled alongside the ceremony where film prizes are awarded.
facts.sourceQuote: Tezamen met het uitreiken van de prijzen worden ook de nieuwe sterren op de Walk of Fame onthuld.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Together with the awarding of the prizes, the new stars on the Walk of Fame will also be revealed.

facts.text: Nieuwe Kerk earned its name because it was Utrecht's first church built specifically for the Reformed faith.
facts.sourceQuote: Het was de eerste kerk in Utrecht die specifiek als Hervormde kerk werd gebouwd, vandaar de naam "Nieuwe" kerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was the first church in Utrecht that was specifically built as a Reformed church, hence the name "Nieuwe" church.

facts.text: The gate featured two round towers and a small watchhouse before the main entrance.
facts.sourceQuote: Over die brug kwam men bij de voorpoort die bestond uit twee ronde torens en een wachthuisje, waarna de hoofdpoort volgde.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Over that bridge you arrived at the main gate, which consisted of two round towers and a small watchhouse, followed by the main gate.

facts.text: Trekschuit boats departed from outside this gate for Amsterdam during the seventeenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: In de 17e en 18e eeuw vertrok buiten de Weerdpoort de Trekschuit naar Amsterdam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 17th and 18th centuries, the Trekschuit departed from outside the Weerdpoort for Amsterdam.

facts.text: City guild members served as the crew responsible for guarding this city gate.
facts.sourceQuote: De bemanning van de stadspoort geschiedde door gildeleden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The crew of the city gate was made up of guild members.

facts.text: Sculptor René van Seumeren created the wooden Mary altar in 1950.
facts.sourceQuote: Het houten Maria-altaar is van de hand van beeldhouwer René van Seumeren en werd geplaatst in 1950.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The wooden Mary altar was made by sculptor René van Seumeren and was placed in 1950.

facts.text: A generous donation by Frans van Seumeren funded the bell tower in 1954.
facts.sourceQuote: Het was een bijzonder gebaar van Frans van Seumeren toen hij in 1954 een beiaard schonk aan de kerk die mede door zijn inzet en geldelijke steun gesticht was.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was a particularly generous gesture from Frans van Seumeren when he donated a bell tower to the church founded in part through his efforts and financial support in 1954.

facts.text: A 12-week siege in the Utrecht war of 1481–83 led to plundering and partial destruction.
facts.sourceQuote: Notably, the tower was besieged for 12 weeks in the Utrecht war of 1481–83, which resulted in its plundering and partial destruction.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Notably, the tower was besieged for 12 weeks in the Utrecht war of 1481–83, which resulted in its plundering and partial destruction.

facts.text: The Hacfort family held possession through marriage from 1711 until 1811.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1711 the Hacfort family took possession the castle through marriage, keeping it until 1811.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1711 the Hacfort family took possession the castle through marriage, keeping it until 1811.

facts.text: Brick walls reach 1.5 meters thick while the tower stands roughly 27 meters high.
facts.sourceQuote: Its brick walls are roughly 1.5 meters thick and stand roughly 27 meters high.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Its brick walls are roughly 1.5 meters thick and stand roughly 27 meters high.

facts.text: Musician Bas Kennis bought the tower in 2016 to convert it into a studio.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2016 the tower was purchased by Bas Kennis, musician with Blof, with the intent of transforming it into a studio.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2016 the tower was purchased by Bas Kennis, musician with Blof, with the intent of transforming it into a studio.

facts.text: A thick earth cover shields the brick barracks from direct hits on all sides except the throat.
facts.sourceQuote: De kazerne is voorzien van een dikke aarddekking, zodat het metselwerk niet werd blootgesteld aan directe treffers. Alleen de keelzijde is onbedekt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The barracks is equipped with a thick earth cover, so that the masonry was not exposed to direct hits. Only the throat side is not covered.

facts.text: Nine distinct parts of the fort carry individual inscriptions in the national monument register.
facts.sourceQuote: Om precies te zijn, zijn er 9 onderdelen op het fort die een inschrijving in het rijksmonumentenregister hebben.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: To be precise, there are 9 parts on the fort that have an inscription in the national register of monuments.

facts.text: The venue was formerly known as the Dick Bruna House before becoming a museum.
facts.sourceQuote: Het nijntje museum (voorheen dick bruna huis) is een museum in het Museumkwartier van de Nederlandse stad Utrecht waar peuters en kleuters hun wereld kunnen ontdekken samen met nijntje en haar vriendjes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Peppa Pig Museum (formerly Dick Bruna House) is a museum in the Museum Quarter of the Dutch city of Utrecht where toddlers and preschoolers can discover their world together with Peppa Pig and her friends.

facts.text: Toddlers and preschoolers explore their world alongside Peppa Pig and her friends here.
facts.sourceQuote: Het nijntje museum (voorheen dick bruna huis) is een museum in het Museumkwartier van de Nederlandse stad Utrecht waar peuters en kleuters hun wereld kunnen ontdekken samen met nijntje en haar vriendjes.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Peppa Pig Museum (formerly Dick Bruna House) is a museum in the Museum Quarter of the Dutch city of Utrecht where toddlers and preschoolers can discover their world together with Peppa Pig and her friends.

facts.text: The venue opened on February 18, 2006 with the author present.
facts.sourceQuote: Het museum werd op 18 februari 2006 als "dick bruna huis" geopend in aanwezigheid van de auteur.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The museum was opened on February 18, 2006 as the "Dick Bruna House" in the presence of the author.

facts.text: Visitors can see over 1200 works including Peppa Pig books and posters.
facts.sourceQuote: Er waren meer dan 1200 werken van Dick Bruna te bewonderen, waaronder de nijntjeboeken en Bruna's eerste boekomslagen, affiches en zijn werk voor Amnesty International, het Rode Kruis en andere organisaties.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There were more than 1200 works by Dick Bruna to admire, including the Peppa Pig books and Bruna's first book covers, posters and his work for Amnesty International, the Red Cross and other organizations.

facts.text: The collection features Bruna's designs for Amnesty International and the Red Cross.
facts.sourceQuote: Er waren meer dan 1200 werken van Dick Bruna te bewonderen, waaronder de nijntjeboeken en Bruna's eerste boekomslagen, affiches en zijn werk voor Amnesty International, het Rode Kruis en andere organisaties.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There were more than 1200 works by Dick Bruna to admire, including the Peppa Pig books and Bruna's first book covers, posters and his work for Amnesty International, the Red Cross and other organizations.

facts.text: The Pniëlkerk takes its name from the biblical place Pniniel.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk vernoemd naar de Bijbelse plaats Pniël, oorspronkelijk gebouwd voor gereformeerden, staat in de buurt Oog in Al.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Named after the biblical place Pniniel, originally built for Reformed people, the church is located near Oog in Al.

facts.text: Architects Piet Dingemans and Sjoerd Wouda designed a hexagonal layout for this structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze is gebouwd in 1954-1955 naar ontwerp van Piet Dingemans en Sjoerd Wouda. Het gebouw heeft een zeshoekige plattegrond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in 1954-1955 according to the design of Piet Dingemans and Sjoerd Wouda. The building has a hexagonal layout.

facts.text: A Chinese Christian Community purchased the church in 2013 after it served a Dutch congregation.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2013 werd de kerk gekocht en in gebruik genomen door de Chinese Christelijke Gemeente in Nederland.Daarvoor zat er een kleine, betrokken PKN-gemeente in het gebouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2013, the church was bought and put into use by the Chinese Christian Community in the Netherlands. Before that, there was a small, involved PKN community in the building.

facts.text: Sjoerd Wouda co-designed the building alongside Piet Dingemans between 1954 and 1955.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze is gebouwd in 1954-1955 naar ontwerp van Piet Dingemans en Sjoerd Wouda.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was built in 1954-1955 according to the design of Piet Dingemans and Sjoerd Wouda.

facts.text: The Baptists moved to this location in 1773 after renovating a medieval canal house.
facts.sourceQuote: Zij kwam in 1773 tot stand door een grondige verbouwing van een middeleeuws grachtenpand onder leiding van de Haarlemse bouwmeester Willem de Haan. Tot dan toe hadden de doopsgezinden gebruikgemaakt van een gebouw aan de Springweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was established in 1773 by a thorough renovation of a medieval canal house under the direction of the Haarlem architect Willem de Haan. Until then, the Baptists had been using a building on Springweg.

facts.text: Haarlem architect Willem de Haan directed the thorough renovation that created the current building.
facts.sourceQuote: Zij kwam in 1773 tot stand door een grondige verbouwing van een middeleeuws grachtenpand onder leiding van de Haarlemse bouwmeester Willem de Haan.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was established in 1773 by a thorough renovation of a medieval canal house under the direction of the Haarlem architect Willem de Haan.

facts.text: In 1599, a legacy from canon Hubert van Buchell added roughly 2,000 volumes to the collection.
facts.sourceQuote: Met een legaat van de gewezen kanunnik Hubert van Buchell kon de stadsbibliotheek in 1599 met circa 2.000 banden worden uitgebreid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With a legacy from the former canon Hubert van Buchell, the city library was able to be expanded with about 2,000 volumes in 1599.

facts.text: The library relocated in 1820 to the former palace of King Louis Napoleon at Wittevrouwenstraat.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1820 verhuisde de universiteitsbibliotheek van de Janskerk naar het voormalig paleis van koning Lodewijk Napoleon aan de Wittevrouwenstraat 7-11.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1820, the university library moved from the Janskerk to the former palace of King Louis Napoleon at Wittevrouwenstraat 7-11.

facts.text: Over four million books were moved in 2004 to a new Science Park building designed by Wiel Arets.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2004 verhuisden in totaal 4,2 miljoen boeken naar een nieuw gebouw in Utrecht Science Park, dat door architect Wiel Arets was ontworpen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2004, a total of 4.2 million books were moved to a new building in Utrecht Science Park, designed by architect Wiel Arets.

facts.text: Since 2012, the historic Wittevrouwenstraat site has served as a city center branch library.
facts.sourceQuote: Het voormalige paleis aan de Wittevrouwenstraat bleef als bibliotheek functioneren: eerst als letterenbibliotheek, en sinds 2012 als vestiging binnenstad van de bibliotheek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The former palace on Wittevrouwenstraat continued to function as a library: first as a literature library, and since 2012 as a branch in the city center of the library.

facts.text: The library's collection grew from about 40 distinct groups to serve seven university faculties.
facts.sourceQuote: Het bezit van de Universiteitsbibliotheek is opgebouwd uit zo'n 40 collecties ter ondersteuning van de zeven faculteiten aan de Universiteit Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The possession of the Universiteitsbibliotheek is built up from about 40 collections to support the seven faculties at the University of Utrecht.

facts.text: Branches exist in the city center and Utrecht Science Park alongside smaller faculty libraries.
facts.sourceQuote: De bibliotheek heeft zowel in de binnenstad van Utrecht als in Utrecht Science Park een vestiging, en kleinere bibliotheken bij de faculteiten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The library has a branch in both the city center of Utrecht and Utrecht Science Park, and smaller libraries at the faculties.

facts.text: Relics of Saint Willibrord, patron saint of the Benelux countries, rest under the main altar.
facts.sourceQuote: Some of the relics of Saint Willibrord, patron saint of the Benelux countries, are kept in the reliquary under the main altar.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Some of the relics of Saint Willibrord, patron saint of the Benelux countries, are kept in the reliquary under the main altar.

facts.text: Tuff walls were split by a central row of sandstone columns.
facts.sourceQuote: Het paleis is gebouwd in tufsteen en was in het midden verdeeld door een rij van zandstenen zuilen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The palace was built of tuff and was divided in the middle by a row of sandstone columns.

facts.text: The chapter later built monastic houses while keeping the old basement as cellars.
facts.sourceQuote: Het perceel wordt daarna toebedeeld aan het kapittel van de Domkerk, dat er claustrale huizen op bouwde. Het voormalig souterrain van het paleis is vanaf dan in gebruik als kelders.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The plot was then allocated to the chapter of the Cathedral, which built monastic houses on it. The former basement of the palace has been in use as cellars since then.

facts.text: A beam floor from the original era was replaced by reinforced concrete in 1934.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1934 brandde het claustrale huis van het Domkapittel op Domplein 16 af. De balkenvloer, waarschijnlijk uit de tijd van Lofen, werd vervangen door een vloer van gewapend beton.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1934, the cloistered house of the Domkapittel on Domplein 16 burned down. The beam floor, probably from the time of Lofen, was replaced by a floor of reinforced concrete.

facts.text: A nine-day fire in 1253 likely destroyed the structure along with many other buildings.
facts.sourceQuote: Als gevolg van een negendaagse stadsbrand in 1253 werden vele gebouwen verwoest, waaronder mogelijk Lofen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As a result of a nine-day city fire in 1253, many buildings were destroyed, including possibly Lofen.

facts.text: Preserved fragments of the palace still exist in basements on the Vismarkt and Domplein.
facts.sourceQuote: Van Lofen zijn fragmenten bewaard gebleven in de kelders van de panden aan de Vismarkt en het Domplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Fragments of Van Lofen have been preserved in the basements of the buildings on the Vismarkt and Domplein.

facts.text: Construction began in 1965 and the church was inaugurated the following year.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw ving aan in 1965 en in 1966 werd de kerk in gebruik genomen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction began in 1965 and the church was inaugurated in 1966.

facts.text: Windows were designed not to reach the ground to prevent distraction from the outside world.
facts.sourceQuote: Ook mochten de ramen niet tot de grond reiken waardoor men door de buitenwereld kon worden afgeleid, maar de ramen mochten ook geen dramatische lichtval geven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The windows were also not allowed to reach the ground so that people could not be distracted by the outside world, but the windows were also not allowed to give dramatic light.

facts.text: The interior lacked column galleries or baptistry stalls to ensure a unified space.
facts.sourceQuote: Zo moest de kerkruimte eenheid uitstralen, zonder doophekken of zuilengalerijen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: For example, the church space had to exude unity, without baptistry stalls or column galleries.

facts.text: Catholics used the church monthly from 1984 after their own building closed.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1984 sloot de naburige katholieke Emmaüskerk de deuren. Zij konden vanaf toen maandelijks gebruikmaken van de Johanneskerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1984, the neighboring Catholic Emmaus Church closed its doors. From then on, they could use the Johanneskerk on a monthly basis.

facts.text: An eagle relief on the facade was designed by actor Carol Linssen.
facts.sourceQuote: Het reliëf op de gevel, een adelaar, is ontworpen door acteur Carol Linssen, zoon van de architect.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The relief on the facade, an eagle, was designed by actor Carol Linssen, son of the architect.

facts.text: Catholic objects like a tabernacle and baptismal font remain inside the church.
facts.sourceQuote: Zij namen ook een aantal voorwerpen mee die nog steeds in de kerk te vinden zijn, zoals het tabernakel, een kruisbeeld en een doopvont.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: They also took with them a number of objects that can still be found in the church, such as the tabernacle, a crucifix and a baptismal font.

facts.text: The Abdij van St. Paulus was dedicated to the Apostle Paul.
facts.sourceQuote: Dedicated to the Apostle Paul, the abbey church was consecrated on 26 June 1050.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Dedicated to the Apostle Paul, the abbey church was consecrated on 26 June 1050.

facts.text: Construction used tuff stone and featured twin towers at the west end.
facts.sourceQuote: It was constructed from tuff stone and featured twin towers at its west end.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was constructed from tuff stone and featured twin towers at its west end.

facts.text: Today only a transept wall remains, integrated into houses on Hofpoort Street.
facts.sourceQuote: Today all that survives of the church is a section of transept wall, integrated into the row of substantial houses that now lines the Hofpoort Street.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Today all that survives of the church is a section of transept wall, integrated into the row of substantial houses that now lines the Hofpoort Street.

facts.text: Declining attendance led to the church closing in 1991 before a Catholic parish took it over.
facts.sourceQuote: Wegens teruglopend kerkbezoek werd de kerk in 1991 buiten dienst genomen. In 1993 werd de kerk overgedragen aan de katholieke Sint-Paulusparochie, die in datzelfde jaar haar oude Pauluskerk aan de Linnaeuslaan verliet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to declining church attendance, the church was taken out of service in 1991. In 1993, the church was transferred to the Catholic St. Paul's parish, which in the same year left its old Pauluskerk on Linnaeuslaan.

facts.text: The current interior features pews and statues moved from a different old Pauluskerk on Linnaeuslaan.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1993 werd de kerk overgedragen aan de katholieke Sint-Paulusparochie, die in datzelfde jaar haar oude Pauluskerk aan de Linnaeuslaan verliet. De kerkbanken, de heiligenbeelden, het altaar, en het tabernakel zijn uit de oude Pauluskerk overgebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1993, the church was transferred to the Catholic St. Paul's parish, which in the same year left its old Pauluskerk on Linnaeuslaan. The pews, the saints' statues, the altar, and the tabernacle have been transferred from the old Pauluskerk.

facts.text: Since 2010, this church has belonged to the merged Sint-Martinus parish rather than a standalone group.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds begin 2010 is de parochie samen met vier andere Utrechtse parochies gefuseerd tot de Sint-Martinusparochie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since the beginning of 2010, the parish has merged with four other Utrecht parishes to form the Sint-Martinus parish.

facts.text: Frederick uten Engh signed documents for the 1576 siege of Vredenburg Castle.
facts.sourceQuote: Frederick uten Engh (Frederick Uuyten Engh) tekende tijdens het beleg van kasteel Vredenburg in de stad Utrecht in 1576/1577 mede de financiële stukken voor de kosten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Frederick uten Engh (Frederick Uuyten Engh) signed the financial documents for the costs during the siege of Vredenburg Castle in the city of Utrecht in 1576/1577.

facts.text: The Lords of den Engh sat in the States of Utrecht as members of the nobility.
facts.sourceQuote: De Heren van den Engh (achternamen uten Engh, van den Engh) hadden als lid van de Ridderschap (adel) van Utrecht zitting in de Staten van Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Lords of den Engh (surnames uten Engh, van den Engh) were members of the Knights (nobility) of Utrecht and sat in the States of Utrecht.

facts.text: Prince Pieter-Christiaan of Orange-Nassau, van Vollenhoven is a notable member of the Utrechtsch Studenten Corps.
facts.sourceQuote: Prins Pieter-Christiaan van Oranje-Nassau, van Vollenhoven – Jack Patijn – Schelto Patijn – François Pauwels – Maarten van Rossem – Jan Herman van Roijen – Bernt Schneiders – Duco Sickinghe – Job van der Steur – Loek des Tombe – Rob van der Voo – Tom Voûte – Johan Wakkie – Peter van Walsum – Max Westerman – Roderick Weusthof – Sander de Wijn – Sweder van Wijnbergen – Anthony Winkler Prins – Herman van der Zandt – Reinier van Lanschot – Rolly van Rappard
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Prince Pieter-Christiaan of Orange-Nassau, van Vollenhoven – Jack Patijn – Schelto Patijn – François Pauwels – Maarten van Rossem – Jan Herman van Roijen – Bernt Schneiders – Duco Sickinghe – Job van der Steur – Loek des Tombe – Rob van der Voo – Tom Voûte – Johan Wakkie – Peter van Walsum – Max Westerman – Roderick Weusthof – Sander de Wijn – Sweder van Wijnbergen – Anthony Winkler Prins – Herman van der Zandt – Reinier van Lanschot – Rolly van Rappard

facts.text: The USC emerged over time rather than having an official founding date.
facts.sourceQuote: Het Utrechtsch Studenten Corps, kortweg U.S.C., de oudste studentenvereniging van Utrecht, werd nooit opgericht maar ontstond gaandeweg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Utrechtsch Studenten Corps, short for U.S.C., the oldest student association in Utrecht, was never officially founded but emerged over time.

facts.text: While 1816 is often cited, it marks the founding of Placet Hic Requiescere Musis instead.
facts.sourceQuote: Vaak wordt als oprichtingsjaar 1816 aangehouden, maar dat is in feite slechts het oprichtingsjaar van de sociëteit Placet Hic Requiescere Musis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Often 1816 is considered the founding year, but that is in fact only the founding year of the society Placet Hic Requiescere Musis.

facts.text: A separate student society for women, U.V.S.V./N.V.V.S.U., was established in 1899.
facts.sourceQuote: Voor vrouwen bestaat sinds 1899 het U.V.S.V./N.V.V.S.U..
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1899, the U.V.S.V./N.V.V.S.U. has existed for women.

facts.text: The archive began in a chest stored inside the Catharijnepoort city gate during the Middle Ages.
facts.sourceQuote: The origin of the Utrecht Archives can be found in a chest with charters, which was stored in one of the city gates during the Middle Ages. This gate was the ‘Catharijnepoort’.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The origin of the Utrecht Archives can be found in a chest with charters, which was stored in one of the city gates during the Middle Ages. This gate was the ‘Catharijnepoort’.

facts.text: Gunpowder storage in the original gate forced the early records to be relocated elsewhere.
facts.sourceQuote: Due to the fact that this gate was also used as a place to store gunpowder, the city archive had to be moved to another location.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Due to the fact that this gate was also used as a place to store gunpowder, the city archive had to be moved to another location.

facts.text: The modern institution formed in 1998 by merging the Public Record Office with the Communal Archive.
facts.sourceQuote: The current Utrecht Archives originated in 1998 from a merger between the Public Record Office and the Communal Archive and Photo Service of Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The current Utrecht Archives originated in 1998 from a merger between the Public Record Office and the Communal Archive and Photo Service of Utrecht.

facts.text: The archive holds over 200 kilometers of documents, images, and publications about Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuote: With over 200 km of archives, images (such as prints, drawings, maps, photos, films) and 70.000 publications, the Archive is the major source of information for the history of Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With over 200 km of archives, images (such as prints, drawings, maps, photos, films) and 70.000 publications, the Archive is the major source of information for the history of Utrecht.

facts.text: Mietje Frijda-Leverpoll was a victim of the Nazi regime who faced persecution or deportation.
facts.sourceQuote: Stolpersteine zijn opgedragen aan slachtoffers van het nationaalsocialisme, al diegenen die zijn vervolgd, gedeporteerd, vermoord, gedwongen te emigreren of tot zelfmoord gedreven door het nazi-regime.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Stolpersteine are dedicated to victims of Nazism, all those who were persecuted, deported, murdered, forced to emigrate or driven to suicide by the Nazi regime.

facts.text: The Themans family chose to remain with children rather than flee when they faced deportation.
facts.sourceQuote: Dezelfde dag plaatste Gunter Demnig vijf Stolpersteine voor het voormalige Centraal Israëlitisch Weeshuis aan de Nieuwegracht: een voor de ongeveer zeventig weeskinderen en hun tien verzorgers en vier voor de familie Themans, die ervoor koos bij de kinderen te blijven toen deze gedeporteerd werden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the same day, Gunter Demnig placed five Stolpersteine in front of the former Central Jewish Orphanage on the Nieuwegracht: one for the approximately seventy orphans and their ten caregivers and four for the Themans family, who chose to stay with the children when they were deported.

facts.text: The Seventh-day Adventist Church purchased the church in 2017.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2017 is de Triumfatorkerk aangekocht door het Kerkgenootschap der Zevende-dags Adventisten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2017, the Triumfatorkerk was purchased by the Seventh-day Adventist Church.

facts.text: A Van Vulpen organ with hand-carved details by Jeannot Bürgi was installed in 1974.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 8 maart 1974 werd een nieuw orgel van Van Vulpen in gebruik genomen waarvan het snijwerk van de hand is van Jeannot Bürgi.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On March 8, 1974, a new organ by Van Vulpen was put into use, whose carving is by hand of Jeannot Bürgi.

facts.text: De Inktpot holds the title of the largest brick building in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: De Inktpot is het grootste bakstenen gebouw in Nederland, ontworpen door George van Heukelom in opdracht van de belangenmaatschap Nederlandse Spoorwegen (NS).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Inktpot is the largest brick building in the Netherlands, designed by George van Heukelom on behalf of the public interest company Dutch Railways (NS).

facts.text: ProRail has operated from this site as its headquarters since 1995.
facts.sourceQuote: Het rijksmonument staat aan het Moreelsepark in Utrecht bij Station Utrecht Centraal en het wordt sinds 1995 gebruikt als hoofdkantoor van ProRail.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The national monument is located in Moreelsepark in Utrecht near Utrecht Central Station and has been used as the headquarters of ProRail since 1995.

facts.text: George van Heukelom designed the structure for the public interest company Dutch Railways.
facts.sourceQuote: De Inktpot is het grootste bakstenen gebouw in Nederland, ontworpen door George van Heukelom in opdracht van de belangenmaatschap Nederlandse Spoorwegen (NS).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Inktpot is the largest brick building in the Netherlands, designed by George van Heukelom on behalf of the public interest company Dutch Railways (NS).

facts.text: The first stone was laid on November 9, 1911 by Bishop Herbert Bury.
facts.sourceQuote: De eerste steen werd gelegd op 9 november 1911 door de anglicaanse bisschop voor Noord-Europa Herbert Bury.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The first stone was laid on November 9, 1911 by the Anglican bishop for Northern Europe Herbert Bury.

facts.text: Architect Petrus Johannes Houtzagers designed the building.
facts.sourceQuote: Architect was Petrus Johannes Houtzagers, de glas-in-loodramen zijn van de hand van Henry Bosdet en zijn geplaatst in de periode tussen 1913 en 1925.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect was Petrus Johannes Houtzagers, the stained glass windows were made by Henry Bosdet and were installed between 1913 and 1925.

facts.text: Stained glass windows by Henry Bosdet were installed between 1913 and 1925.
facts.sourceQuote: Architect was Petrus Johannes Houtzagers, de glas-in-loodramen zijn van de hand van Henry Bosdet en zijn geplaatst in de periode tussen 1913 en 1925.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The architect was Petrus Johannes Houtzagers, the stained glass windows were made by Henry Bosdet and were installed between 1913 and 1925.

facts.text: The tower lacks visible buttresses despite its immense height.
facts.sourceQuote: One of the most striking features is the absence of visible buttresses.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: One of the most striking features is the absence of visible buttresses.

facts.text: Restorations in 1910 raised the height to 112.5 metres.
facts.sourceQuote: However the height was increased during the restorations in 1910, to its present height of 112.5 metres.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However the height was increased during the restorations in 1910, to its present height of 112.5 metres.

facts.text: Preacher Geert Groote protested the project as too vain and expensive.
facts.sourceQuote: Its construction led preacher Geert Groote to protest against the vanity of such an immense project, suggesting it was too tall, too expensive and all but aesthetic.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Its construction led preacher Geert Groote to protest against the vanity of such an immense project, suggesting it was too tall, too expensive and all but aesthetic.

facts.text: A private chapel for the Bishop occupied the first floor.
facts.sourceQuote: In addition to being a belfry, it contained a private chapel of the Bishop of Utrecht on the first floor.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In addition to being a belfry, it contained a private chapel of the Bishop of Utrecht on the first floor.

facts.text: At 112.32 metres, it stands as the tallest church tower in the Netherlands.
facts.sourceQuote: The Dom Tower (Dutch: Domtoren 'Cathedral Tower') of Utrecht is the tallest church tower in the Netherlands, at 112.32 metres (368.5 feet) in height.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dom Tower (Dutch: Domtoren 'Cathedral Tower') of Utrecht is the tallest church tower in the Netherlands, at 112.32 metres (368.5 feet) in height.

facts.text: Since its nave collapsed in 1674, the structure has stood alone as a freestanding tower.
facts.sourceQuote: Since the unfinished nave collapsed in 1674, the Dom tower has been a freestanding tower.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since the unfinished nave collapsed in 1674, the Dom tower has been a freestanding tower.

facts.text: Houtzaagmolen De Ster takes its name from the first owner, Arien van der Starren.
facts.sourceQuote: De naam van de molen De Ster is afgeleid van de naam van de eerste eigenaar Arien van der Starren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name of the mill De Ster is derived from the name of the first owner Arien van der Starren.

facts.text: The mill's main shaft is a 6.01-meter-long colossus weighing 3500 kilograms.
facts.sourceQuote: Half februari 1998 is door de ijzergieterij Gieterij Hardinxveld te Hardinxveld-Giesendam de reusachtige bovenas van De Ster gegoten. Deze kolos van 6,01 meter lang heeft een doorsnede van 50 centimeter, weegt 3500 kilo en heeft nummer 79.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In mid-February 1998, the gigantic upper shaft of De Ster was cast by the iron foundry Gieterij Hardinxveld in Hardinxveld-Giesendam. This colossus 6.01 meters long has a cross-section of 50 centimeters, weighs 3500 kilograms and has number 79.

facts.text: Prince Claus officially opened the restored mill on June 22, 1999.
facts.sourceQuote: Na voltooiing van de molen, compleet met zaaginrichting en het 'gaande werk' zoals de bovenas, de krukas en het zaagraam, volgde op 22 juni 1999 de officiële opening. Die geschiedde door Z.K.H. prins Claus, beschermheer van de Vereniging De Hollandsche Molen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After completion of the mill, complete with sawing equipment and the 'running work' such as the main shaft, the crank shaft and the saw frame, the official opening took place on June 22, 1999. This took place by His Royal Highness Prince Claus, patron of the Association De Hollandsche Molen.

facts.text: Artist Tjeerd Visser crafted a three-meter brass statue with a thick base and pointed tip.
facts.sourceQuote: Kunstenaar Tjeerd Visser ontwierp een drie meter hoog messing beeld dat de strijd weerspiegelt om het Esperanto-ideaal te verwezenlijken; de forse onderkant van het beeld is de grote moeite die gedaan is, en de spits toelopende punt verwijst naar het doel: "van chaos naar gerichtheid en eenheid".
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Artist Tjeerd Visser designed a three-meter-high brass statue that reflects the struggle to realize the Esperanto ideal; the thick bottom of the statue is the great effort made, and the pointed tip refers to the goal: "from chaos to direction and unity".

facts.text: Six Esperantomonument exist in the Netherlands, though one on Vlieland and a Zwolle sculpture have vanished.
facts.sourceQuote: In Nederland zijn zes van dit soort monumenten: in de plaatsen Bergen op Zoom, Den Burg, Leeuwarden, Utrecht en Zwolle. Op Vlieland heeft in het verleden een monument gestaan en ook een van de sculpturen in Zwolle is verdwenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In Nederland there are six of these types of monuments: in the towns of Bergen op Zoom, Den Burg, Leeuwarden, Utrecht and Zwolle. In the past, there was a monument on Vlieland and one of the sculptures in Zwolle has also disappeared.

facts.text: The monuments feature five-pointed stars and globes to symbolize the five continents.
facts.sourceQuote: Toegepaste symboliek in de monumenten zijn onder andere de vijfpuntige ster en de wereldbol, verwijzend naar de vijf werelddelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Applied symbolism in the monuments includes the five-pointed star and the globe, referring to the five continents.

facts.text: The statue's model was Johanna Antoinette de Boer, whose parents were friends with the sculptor.
facts.sourceQuote: Johanna Antoinette de Boer, gehuwd Blakenburg, (geboren 02-01-1929 overleden 01-10-2025) stond model voor dit kunstwerk. Haar ouders waren bevriend met de kunstenares.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Johanna Antoinette de Boer, married Blakenburg, (born 02-01-1929 died 01-10-2025) was the model for this work of art. Her parents were friends with the artist.

facts.text: The artist carved the figure from a boiler house originally belonging to the Hague gas factory.
facts.sourceQuote: Franzén-Heslenfeld hakte het beeld in een ketelhuis van de Haagse gasfabriek, ze werd bij de uitvoering geassisteerd door Giuseppe Roverso en Wladimir de Vries.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Franzén-Heslenfeld carved the image into a boiler house from the Hague gas factory, she was assisted by Giuseppe Roverso and Wladimir de Vries during the execution.

facts.text: A female figure was chosen to reflect the high proportion of Utrecht women in the resistance.
facts.sourceQuote: Er is bewust gekozen voor een vrouwenfiguur, vanwege het aandeel van de Utrechtse vrouwen in het verzet.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A female figure was deliberately chosen, due to the proportion of Utrecht women in the resistance.

facts.text: Jan Engelman wrote a poem about carrying on the flame of those who fought for justice.
facts.sourceQuote: In de sokkel is een gedicht aangebracht van Jan Engelman: Gedenk uw dooden die den goeden strijd gestreden hebben in gerechtigheid. Draagt voort hun vlam, zij zijn gebleven, maar in dien gloed wordt ons nieuw leven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the base is a poem by Jan Engelman: Remember your dead who fought the good fight in justice. Carry on their flame, they have remained, but in that glow is our new life.

facts.text: The house originally included a garage even though the owner Truus Schröder never owned a car.
facts.sourceQuote: Additionally, the house included a garage, which was very strange because Truus did not own a car.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Additionally, the house included a garage, which was very strange because Truus did not own a car.

facts.text: Sliding and revolving panels allow the upstairs living area to transform between open space and separate rooms.
facts.sourceQuote: This was achieved with a system of sliding and revolving panels. Mrs Schröder used these panels to open up the space of the second floor to allow more of an open area for her and her 3 children, leaving the option of closing or separating the rooms when desired.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This was achieved with a system of sliding and revolving panels. Mrs Schröder used these panels to open up the space of the second floor to allow more of an open area for her and her 3 children, leaving the option of closing or separating the rooms when desired.

facts.text: A circular opening was cut into a sliding wall because it blocked access to both a cupboard and a light switch.
facts.sourceQuote: A sliding wall between the living area and the son's room blocks a cupboard as well as a light switch. Therefore, a circular opening was made within the sliding wall.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A sliding wall between the living area and the son's room blocks a cupboard as well as a light switch. Therefore, a circular opening was made within the sliding wall.

facts.text: Concrete was originally planned but deemed too expensive for the small structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Initially, Rietveld wanted to construct the house out of concrete. It turned out that it would be too expensive to do that on such a small building.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Initially, Rietveld wanted to construct the house out of concrete. It turned out that it would be too expensive to do that on such a small building.

facts.text: Only the foundations and balconies are made of concrete while walls use brick.
facts.sourceQuote: The foundations and the balconies were the only parts of the building that were made out of concrete. The walls were made of brick and plaster.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The foundations and the balconies were the only parts of the building that were made out of concrete. The walls were made of brick and plaster.

facts.text: Wood frames the windows and doors while wooden beams support the floors.
facts.sourceQuote: The window frames and doors were made from wood as well as the floors, which were supported by wooden beams.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The window frames and doors were made from wood as well as the floors, which were supported by wooden beams.

facts.text: Neighbors voluntarily donated personal belongings and shared stories to preserve neighborhood identity.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Neighbors voluntarily handed over personal belongings upon request and were interviewed to keep the identity of the neighborhood alive.

facts.text: Five Stolpersteine were placed for orphans and caregivers at the former Central Jewish Orphanage on Nieuwegracht.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On the same day, Gunter Demnig placed five Stolpersteine in front of the former Central Jewish Orphanage on the Nieuwegracht: one for the approximately seventy orphans and their ten caregivers and four for the Themans family, who chose to stay with the children when they were deported.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church building was built around 1931 in the Schildersbuurt on the corner of Hobbemastraat and Paulus Potterstraat.

facts.text: Since 1984, the collection has resided in the medieval Buurkerk and was opened by Queen Beatrix.

facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Among the instruments on display are music boxes, musical clocks, pianolas, barrel organs (including the typically Dutch large street organs) and a turret clock with a carillon, most of which are still able to play for visitors.

facts.text: The Celsius student team won three awards in the 2021 Solar Decathlon Build Challenge.

facts.text: A sale condition required removing towers and straightening arches so the street view no longer looked like a church.
facts.sourceQuote: Voorwaarde bij de verkoop was echter dat het gebouw er vanaf de straat niet meer uit mocht zien als kerk. De karakteristieke torentjes werden verwijderd, de spitsboogramen werden rechtgetrokken en het voorportaal werd afgebroken en vervangen door een voorhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, the condition for the sale was that the building could no longer look like a church from the street. The characteristic towers were removed, the pointed arches were straightened and the front portal was demolished and replaced by a front house.

facts.text: From 1941, the trailer factory Hollandia operated within this structure.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf 1941 was in het gebouw de zijspanfabriek Hollandia gevestigd en vanaf 1977 werd het een metaalfabriek.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1941, the trailer factory Hollandia was located in the building and from 1977 it became a metal factory.

facts.text: A single Stolperstein in Utrecht honors approximately seventy orphans and ten caregivers together.

facts.text: A victim's relative first requested a monument in early 2001 following the 1962 Harmelen disaster.
facts.sourceQuote: Begin 2001 verzocht een nabestaande van een slachtoffer van de treinramp bij Harmelen (1962) de NS om een monument voor dit ongeval.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: At the beginning of 2001, a relative of a victim of the train disaster in Harmelen (1962) asked the NS to erect a monument for this accident.

facts.text: Anton Broos designed and created the monument.
facts.sourceQuote: Het monument is ontworpen en gemaakt door Anton Broos en werd onthuld in 2004.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monument was designed and made by Anton Broos and was unveiled in 2004.

facts.text: PVCV switched from Sunday to Saturday competition in 2022/23 via a KNVB transfer scheme.
facts.sourceQuote: Van oudsher speelde het eerste elftal van PVCV in de zondagcompetitie. In het seizoen 2022/23 werd overgestapt naar de zaterdagcompetitie, middels een 'horizontale' overstapregeling van de KNVB kon de club op zaterdag in dezelfde klasse verder. = Dit seizoen werd stopgezet vanwege de uitbraak van het coronavirus.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Traditionally, PVCV's first team played in the Sunday competition. In the 2022/23 season, the club switched to the Saturday competition, thanks to a 'horizontal' transfer scheme of the KNVB, the club could continue in the same class on Saturday. = This season was suspended due to the outbreak of the coronavirus.

facts.text: The 2022/23 season was suspended due to the coronavirus outbreak with no official final standings.

facts.text: In 2017, Hercules led FC Groningen 1–0 before losing the KNVB Cup match 2–1.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2017, USV Hercules led 1–0 against FC Groningen in the national KNVB Cup but went on to lose the game 2–1.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2017, USV Hercules led 1–0 against FC Groningen in the national KNVB Cup but went on to lose the game 2–1.

facts.text: The club reached the Derde Divisie in 2014 after only one year in the Hoofdklasse.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2014 it joined the Derde Divisie (then still known as Topklasse) after playing just one year in the Hoofdklasse.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2014 it joined the Derde Divisie (then still known as Topklasse) after playing just one year in the Hoofdklasse.

facts.text: King Willem-Alexander officially inaugurated the venue on July 3, 2014.
facts.sourceQuote: Official opening ceremonies began on 27 June 2014, with the venue being inaugurated by King Willem-Alexander on 3 July 2014.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Official opening ceremonies began on 27 June 2014, with the venue being inaugurated by King Willem-Alexander on 3 July 2014.

facts.text: Rubber suspension was installed in support pillars to stop sound bleeding between halls.
facts.sourceQuote: In June 2015, the venue fixed complaints of sound bleed between the Ronda and Hertz halls with the placement of rubber suspension in the building's support pillars and sound-insulating plates in the Ronda's roof.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In June 2015, the venue fixed complaints of sound bleed between the Ronda and Hertz halls with the placement of rubber suspension in the building's support pillars and sound-insulating plates in the Ronda's roof.

facts.text: A cleaner fatally stabbed a coworker during a fight inside the venue in November 2023.
facts.sourceQuote: In November 2023, a fatal stabbing took place in TivoliVredenburg. The suspect was a cleaner who killed his coworker after a fight.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In November 2023, a fatal stabbing took place in TivoliVredenburg. The suspect was a cleaner who killed his coworker after a fight.

facts.text: The venue reopened in February 2022 after closing for two years due to the pandemic.
facts.sourceQuote: In March 2020, the venue shut its doors and postponed hundreds of concerts because of the COVID-19 pandemic. It reopened in February 2022, after two years of limited hours and restrictions.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In March 2020, the venue shut its doors and postponed hundreds of concerts because of the COVID-19 pandemic. It reopened in February 2022, after two years of limited hours and restrictions.

facts.text: The venue was named TivoliVredenburg to honor two nationally famous music brands.
facts.sourceQuote: In October 2012, it was announced that the venue would be named TivoliVredenburg, because both Tivoli and Vredenburg were nationally well known names in the pop and classical music worlds, respectively.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In October 2012, it was announced that the venue would be named TivoliVredenburg, because both Tivoli and Vredenburg were nationally well known names in the pop and classical music worlds, respectively.

facts.text: The old Muziekcentrum Vredenburg was demolished in 2011 to build the new site.
facts.sourceQuote: All plans were approved by the city in 2010 and the Muziekcentrum Vredenburg was demolished in 2011 to make way for the new music venue, which was originally given the name Muziekpaleis Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: All plans were approved by the city in 2010 and the Muziekcentrum Vredenburg was demolished in 2011 to make way for the new music venue, which was originally given the name Muziekpaleis Utrecht.

facts.text: A twenty-four meter high dome rests on six pillars.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk heeft een zeshoekige vorm, welke vorm terugkomt in de vierentwintig meter hoge koepel, die wordt gesteund door zes pilaren.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church has a hexagonal shape, which shape is reflected in the twenty-four meter high dome, which is supported by six pillars.

facts.text: The organ dates from 1810 and was salvaged from a demolished church on Biltstraat.
facts.sourceQuote: Het uit 1810 daterende tweeklaviers orgel is afkomstig uit de gesloopte Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-ten-Hemelopnemingkerk (Biltstraatkerk).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The two-manual organ dating from 1810 comes from the demolished Onze-Lieve-Vrouw-ten-Hemelopnemingkerk (Biltstraatkerk).

facts.text: Bishop Gerard de Korte was ordained a priest within this church building.
facts.sourceQuote: De Bossche bisschop Gerard de Korte werd in deze kerk tot priester gewijd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Bishop of Bossum, Gerard de Korte, was ordained a priest in this church.

facts.text: In 1342, Wstinc wrote the Statuta ecclesie Trajectensis, a legal code for the Cathedral.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1342 schreef hij zijn werk Statuta ecclesie Trajectensis, bekend geworden als Liber camere of Camerboeck van de Dom.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1342 he wrote his work Statuta ecclesie Trajectensis, known as Liber camere or Camerboeck of the Cathedral.

facts.text: Wstinc served as an arbitrator resolving disputes between Utrecht and its chapters with renowned wisdom.
facts.sourceQuote: Hij trad geregeld als bemiddelaar op bij geschillen tussen Utrecht en de kapittels en werd geroemd om zijn inzicht en wijsheid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: He regularly acted as an arbitrator in disputes between Utrecht and the chapters and was renowned for his insight and wisdom.

facts.text: The name Buurkerk combines buur (neighbour) and kerk.
facts.sourceQuote: The name Buurkerk is made up of the words buur (neighbour) and kerk (church).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The name Buurkerk is made up of the words buur (neighbour) and kerk (church).

facts.text: A cannon in the tower aimed at Vredenburg castle during a 1577 siege.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1577 a cannon was installed in the church tower, aimed at the Vredenburg castle where the Charles V's Spanish soldiers there were under siege by the Utrecht schutters.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1577 a cannon was installed in the church tower, aimed at the Vredenburg castle where the Charles V's Spanish soldiers there were under siege by the Utrecht schutters.

facts.text: The tower dates from 1370 but was never finished.
facts.sourceQuote: The tower dates from 1370, but was never finished.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The tower dates from 1370, but was never finished.

facts.text: Since January 2019, an evangelical church following the Hillsong concept has occupied this former sanctuary.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds januari 2019 wordt het gebouw gebruikt door Motion Church, een evangelische gemeente naar het Hillsong-concept.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since January 2019, the building has been used by Motion Church, an evangelical church following the Hillsong concept.

facts.text: A unique contemplation room for all denominations exists alongside the main prayer hall.
facts.sourceQuote: Besides the Islamic prayer hall, the building also host a room for contemplation for people from any other denomination. The board of the mosque decided to create such a room, unique in the world, since the neighborhood surrounding the mosque has also a substantial Christian and Jewish population.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Besides the Islamic prayer hall, the building also host a room for contemplation for people from any other denomination. The board of the mosque decided to create such a room, unique in the world, since the neighborhood surrounding the mosque has also a substantial Christian and Jewish population.

facts.text: Glass brick minarets glow with light after sunset.
facts.sourceQuote: The glass brick minarets are lighted with light after sunset.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The glass brick minarets are lighted with light after sunset.

facts.text: Funding comes from donations by Turkish communities across the Netherlands, Belgium, and Germany.
facts.sourceQuote: Funding is however based on donations from the Turkish communities in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Funding is however based on donations from the Turkish communities in the Netherlands, Belgium and Germany.

facts.text: The Reformed congregation left in 1995 and merged with another group at the Pniël church.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1995 verlieten de hervormden dit kerkgebouw. Vanuit het Samen op Weg-proces werd besloten om de gereformeerde en de hervormde gemeente van Oog en Al samen te voegen. In 1995 gingen ze samen verder in de Pniëlkerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1995, the Reformed left this church building. From the Samen op Weg process, it was decided to merge the Reformed and Reformed Church of Oog en Al. In 1995 they continued together in the Pniël church.

facts.text: Between 1987 and 1995, the Old Evangelical Lutheran church held services in the annex building.
facts.sourceQuote: In het bijgebouw kwam tussen 1987 en 1995 ook de Oud-Evangelisch-Lutherse gemeente samen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Between 1987 and 1995, the Old Evangelical Lutheran church also met in the annex building.

facts.text: Father and son Gijs and Teus van Hoogevest designed the building.
facts.sourceQuote: Het kerkgebouw werd in 1952 gebouwd naar een ontwerp van vader en zoon Gijs en Teus van Hoogevest.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church building was built in 1952 according to a design by father and son Gijs and Teus van Hoogevest.

facts.text: The institution began as a school in 1854 before becoming a university in 1986.
facts.sourceQuote: The university was founded in 1854 as the Theological School ("Theologische School") by the Christian Reformed Church in the Netherlands, a church resulting from a schism in 1834, to provide for theological education for its ministers. The name was changed to Theological College ("Theologische Hogeschool") in 1939 and finally to Theological University in 1986, after a reform in the Dutch university/polytechnic system.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The university was founded in 1854 as the Theological School ("Theologische School") by the Christian Reformed Church in the Netherlands, a church resulting from a schism in 1834, to provide for theological education for its ministers. The name was changed to Theological College ("Theologische Hogeschool") in 1939 and finally to Theological University in 1986, after a reform in the Dutch university/polytechnic system.

facts.text: A 1944 schism caused parts of the university to split and form a new institute in Kampen.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1944, another schism within the Reformed Church in the Netherlands occurred, called the Liberation ("Vrijmaking"), which resulted in the Reformed Churches in the Netherlands (Liberated). This new church also had a need for its own ministerial education institute, and so a new university was founded from parts of the Theological University: Kampen Theological University of the Reformed Church (Liberated).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1944, another schism within the Reformed Church in the Netherlands occurred, called the Liberation ("Vrijmaking"), which resulted in the Reformed Churches in the Netherlands (Liberated). This new church also had a need for its own ministerial education institute, and so a new university was founded from parts of the Theological University: Kampen Theological University of the Reformed Church (Liberated).

facts.text: Students can study general Calvinist theology here without intending to become ministers.
facts.sourceQuote: The Protestant Theological University primarily caters for ministerial education and as such is one of three institutes recognised by the PKN, but it is also possible to study general (Calvinist) theology without wishing to become a minister.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Protestant Theological University primarily caters for ministerial education and as such is one of three institutes recognised by the PKN, but it is also possible to study general (Calvinist) theology without wishing to become a minister.

facts.text: The Protestantse Theologische Universiteit is one of three institutes officially recognised by the PKN.
