facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Protestant Theological University primarily caters for ministerial education and as such is one of three institutes recognised by the PKN, but it is also possible to study general (Calvinist) theology without wishing to become a minister.

facts.text: Architect Herman van Putten designed the church in the Bossche School style.
facts.sourceQuote: De kerk is gebouwd in 1951 en ontworpen door Herman van Putten in de stijl van de Bossche School.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The church was built in 1951 and designed by Herman van Putten in the style of the Bossche School.

facts.text: Bishop Alfrink consecrated the building on November 22, 1951.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 22 november 1951 werd de kerk ingewijd door mgr. Alfrink.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On November 22, 1951, the church was consecrated by Bishop. Alfrink.

facts.text: Dominican fathers maintained a small community there until it dissolved in 1992.
facts.sourceQuote: Vanaf de oprichting hebben de paters dominicanen er een kleine communiteit gehad. In 1992 werd de communiteit opgeheven, maar de dominicaanse spiritualiteit wordt nog steeds doorgegeven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since its founding, the Dominican fathers have had a small community there. The community was dissolved in 1992, but Dominican spirituality is still being passed down.

facts.text: In 2010, this church merged with five others to form the Ludgerus Parish.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2010 fuseerde de Dominicuskerk met vijf andere kerken in Utrecht tot de Ludgerusparochie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2010, Dominicuskerk merged with five other churches in Utrecht to form the Ludgerus Parish.

facts.text: Original red sandstone columns were rebuilt as square pillars in the thirteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: De ronde zuilen uit rode zandsteen werden echter in de dertiende eeuw ommetseld tot vierkante pijlers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: However, the round columns of red sandstone were rebuilt in the thirteenth century into square pillars.

facts.text: The choir served as a city library from the Reformation until 1821.
facts.sourceQuote: Na de Reformatie werd het koor ingericht als stadsbibliotheek (de voorloper van de universiteitsbibliotheek), terwijl de Waalse en Engelse gemeenten in de rest van het gebouw kerkten. In 1656 werd de Janskerk in gebruik genomen als Nederduits Gereformeerde kerk, hoewel de bibliotheek van de Utrechtse universiteit nog tot 1821 in het koor gehuisvest bleef.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the Reformation, the choir was set up as a city library (the predecessor of the university library), while the Walloon and English municipalities in the rest of the building were churches. In 1656, the Janskerk was put into use as a Low German Reformed church, although the library of the Utrecht university remained housed in the choir until 1821.

facts.text: Janskerk means "John's Church" because it was dedicated to John the Baptist.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze werd kort na 1040 gesticht door bisschop Bernold en gewijd aan Johannes de Doper.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was founded shortly after 1040 by Bishop Bernold and dedicated to John the Baptist.

facts.text: Bishop Bernold founded this church shortly after the year 1040.
facts.sourceQuote: Ze werd kort na 1040 gesticht door bisschop Bernold en gewijd aan Johannes de Doper.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was founded shortly after 1040 by Bishop Bernold and dedicated to John the Baptist.

facts.text: A large fire broke out at KidZcity on April 18, 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 18 april 2008 woedde er een grote brand in KidZcity.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On April 18, 2008, a large fire broke out in KidZcity.

facts.text: Despite a public presence during the blaze, no visitors were injured.
facts.sourceQuote: Hoewel er publiek aanwezig was op het moment dat de brand uitbrak zijn er geen bezoekers gewond geraakt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Although there was a public presence at the time the fire broke out, no visitors were injured.

facts.text: KidZcity reopened following renovations after the autumn holidays of 2008.
facts.sourceQuote: KidZcity werd gerenoveerd en sinds de herfstvakantie van 2008 is het weer geopend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: KidZcity was renovated and has been open again since the autumn holidays of 2008.

facts.text: Children up to age twelve can enjoy bumper cars and laser games alongside climbing walls.
facts.sourceQuote: Hier kunnen kinderen tot 12 jaar klimmen, glijden, rennen en springen. Er zijn verschillende attracties waaronder draaimolens, lasergame en botsauto's.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Here children up to 12 years old can climb, slide, run and jump. There are several attractions including Ferris wheels, laser game and bumper cars.

facts.text: Construction spanned from 1818 to 1821 as part of the New Holland Water Line.
facts.sourceQuote: Het fort is in 1818-1821 gebouwd als onderdeel van de Nieuwe Hollandse Waterlinie en is een van de grootste forten van de linie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The fort was built in 1818-1821 as part of the New Holland Water Line and is one of the largest forts of the line.

facts.text: A waiting house measuring 30 by 20 meters features three vaulted rooms and a water cellar.
facts.sourceQuote: Het wachthuis A werd tussen 1849 en 1852 gebouwd en kreeg een eigen gracht. Het wachthuis is 30 meter lang en 20 meter breed. Binnen zijn drie overwelfde ruimten voor het verblijf van de manschappen en de opslag, een waterkelder en een trappenhuis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The waiting house A was built between 1849 and 1852 and received its own moat. The waiting house is 30 meters long and 20 meters wide. Inside are three vaulted rooms for the accommodation of the men and storage, a water cellar and a staircase.

facts.text: During WWI mobilization, over 300 men occupied the fort as an infantry support point.
facts.sourceQuote: Tijdens de mobilisatie voor de Eerste Wereldoorlog bestond de bezetting van Blauwkapel uit ruim 300 man. Het fort functioneerde als infanteriesteunpunt met loopgraven, militairopstellingen en observatieposten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the mobilization for the First World War, the occupation of Blauwkapel consisted of more than 300 men. The fort functioned as an infantry support point with trenches, military positions and observation posts.

facts.text: A large chalet-style shed from 1883 stands 47 meters long with timber framing filled with brick.
facts.sourceQuote: De grote rechthoekige loods van 47 meter lang en 11 meter breed is uitgevoerd in een chaletachtige stijl met vakwerk, ingevuld met baksteen. In de voorgevel is het jaartal 1883 aangebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The large rectangular shed 47 meters long and 11 meters wide is made in a chalet-like style with timber framing, filled with brick. The year 1883 is inscribed on the front facade.

facts.text: The collection expanded by 2,000 volumes in 1599 thanks to a legacy from canon Hubert van Buchell.
facts.sourceQuote: Met een legaat van de gewezen kanunnik Hubert van Buchell kon de stadsbibliotheek in 1599 met circa 2.000 banden worden uitgebreid.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: With a legacy from the former canon Hubert van Buchell, the city library was able to be expanded with about 2,000 volumes in 1599.

facts.text: Architect Wiel Arets designed the new building in Utrecht Science Park that opened in 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2004 verhuisden in totaal 4,2 miljoen boeken naar een nieuw gebouw in Utrecht Science Park, dat door architect Wiel Arets was ontworpen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2004, a total of 4.2 million books were moved to a new building in Utrecht Science Park, designed by architect Wiel Arets.

facts.text: In 2004, 4.2 million books were moved to the new Science Park location.
facts.sourceQuote: In 2004 verhuisden in totaal 4,2 miljoen boeken naar een nieuw gebouw in Utrecht Science Park, dat door architect Wiel Arets was ontworpen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 2004, a total of 4.2 million books were moved to a new building in Utrecht Science Park, designed by architect Wiel Arets.

facts.text: Special Collections preserve manuscripts, pre-1901 books, rare volumes, and maps.
facts.sourceQuote: Daaronder zijn ook de Bijzondere Collecties met handschriften, boeken van voor 1901, zeldzame of kostbare boeken en kaarten.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: These include the Special Collections with manuscripts, books from before 1901, rare or valuable books and maps.

facts.text: A 1520 ship's letter marks the first recorded appearance of this stone under its current name.
facts.sourceQuote: Deze zwerfkei schijnt voor het eerst onder deze noemer vermeld te worden in een schepenbrief uit 1520.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: This stray stone apparently appears for the first time under this heading in a ship's letter from 1520.

facts.text: The corner building housing the chained stone operated as a cigar factory during the nineteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Het naar de steen vernoemde hoekpand Eligenhof/Oudegracht 364 waar de steen aan is vastgeketend, vormde in de 19e eeuw een sigarenfabriek van G.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The corner building named after the stone Eligenhof/Oudegracht 364 where the stone is chained to, formed a cigar factory of G in the 19th century.

facts.text: Locals also call De Gesloten Steen the devil's stone.
facts.sourceQuote: De Gesloten Steen (ook wel duivelssteen genoemd) is een zware zwerfsteen in het centrum van Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Gesloten Steen (also known as devil's stone) is a heavy stray stone in the center of Utrecht.

facts.text: The corner building at Oudegracht and Eligenhof takes its name from this monument.
facts.sourceQuote: De rijksmonumentale steen ligt vastgeketend op de hoek Oudegracht en het Eligenhof aan een hoekpand dat zijn naam eraan heeft ontleend.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The national monument stone is chained to the corner of Oudegracht and the Eligenhof on a corner building that has taken its name from it.

facts.text: The cinema rooms were built partly underground in the courtyard to respect height limits.
facts.sourceQuote: De zalen zijn op de binnenplaats gebouwd, deels onder de grond, omdat men gebonden was aan een maximumhoogte.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The rooms were built on the courtyard, partly underground, because they were bound by a maximum height.

facts.text: Actor Louis Hartlooper's son officially opened the complex on September 5, 2004.
facts.sourceQuote: De officiële opening was op 5 september 2004 door Louis Hartlooper jr., de zoon van acteur en explicateur Louis Hartlooper.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The official opening was on September 5, 2004 by Louis Hartlooper Jr., the son of actor and explainer Louis Hartlooper.

facts.text: The venue honors Louis Hartlooper, a celebrated figure in Utrecht's film history.
facts.sourceQuote: Filmmaker en bioscoopeigenaar Jos Stelling nam het initiatief tot dit filmtheater dat hij vernoemde naar acteur en filmexplicateur Louis Hartlooper, een bekend persoon uit de Utrechtse filmgeschiedenis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Filmmaker and cinema owner Jos Stelling took the initiative for this film theater, which he named after actor and film explainer Louis Hartlooper, a well-known person in the Utrecht film history.

facts.text: Filmmaker Jos Stelling initiated the project and established the theater.
facts.sourceQuote: Filmmaker en bioscoopeigenaar Jos Stelling nam het initiatief tot dit filmtheater dat hij vernoemde naar acteur en filmexplicateur Louis Hartlooper, een bekend persoon uit de Utrechtse filmgeschiedenis.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Filmmaker and cinema owner Jos Stelling took the initiative for this film theater, which he named after actor and film explainer Louis Hartlooper, a well-known person in the Utrecht film history.

facts.text: Five distinct screens showcase arthouse films, world cinema, and classic movies.
facts.sourceQuote: Het LHC heeft vergader- en tentoonstellingsruimte, een restaurant, café, salon, terras en vijf filmzalen voor onder andere arthouse, wereldcinema en klassiekers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The LHC has meeting and exhibition space, a restaurant, café, salon, terrace and five movie theaters for arthouse, world cinema and classics, among other things.

facts.text: The venue contains three separate screening halls with a combined capacity of 683 seats.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop maakt deel uit van de bioscoopketen Pathé en heeft drie zalen (het kleinste aantal van alle bioscopen van Pathé in Nederland) met in totaal 683 zitplaatsen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema is part of the Pathé cinema chain and has three halls (the smallest number of all Pathé cinemas in the Netherlands) with a total of 683 seats.

facts.text: In 1929-1930, a straight road cut the fort in two, dividing it into separate halves.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1929-1930 werd daarom de Biltse straatweg, inclusief de dubbelsporige baan van de inmiddels elektrische tram, uiteindelijk dwars door het fort heen getrokken, waardoor het in twee helften werd gesplitst.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1929-1930, the Biltse street road, including the double-track track of the now electric tram, was finally pulled straight through the fort, dividing it into two halves.

facts.text: Nicolaas van Haaren designed bombproof barracks capable of housing 208 men during modernization.
facts.sourceQuote: De laatste moderniseringswerken werden uitgevoerd door Nicolaas van Haaren. Hij bouwde er een bomvrije kazerne voor 208 manschappen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The last modernization works were carried out by Nicolaas van Haaren. He built a bombproof barracks for 208 men there.

facts.text: Commemorative stones listing 139 executed resistance fighters contained many historical errors.
facts.sourceQuote: In die periode zouden hier volgens de daar neergelegde naamstenen 139 verzetsstrijders zijn gefusilleerd. In 2022 bleek uit een artikel van historisch onderzoeker Jim Terlingen dat er veel fouten zijn gemaakt op deze herdenkingsstenen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: According to the name stones placed there during that period, 139 resistance fighters were executed here during that period. In 2022, an article by historical researcher Jim Terlingen revealed that many mistakes were made on these commemorative stones.

facts.text: The name Centraal Museum comes from the Dutch word for central.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1921 the collection merged with various private collections in the new 'centralised museum' (hence the name 'Centraal museum', centraal being the Dutch word for central) located in the former medieval monastery at the Nicolaaskerkhof.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1921 the collection merged with various private collections in the new 'centralised museum' (hence the name 'Centraal museum', centraal being the Dutch word for central) located in the former medieval monastery at the Nicolaaskerkhof.

facts.text: Since 2006, the museum has operated the nearby Miffy Museum dedicated to Dick Bruna's famous rabbit character.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 1980, the museum includes the collection of the Van Baaren Museum and since 2006, the museum also runs the Miffy Museum, a museum across the street dedicated to Dick Bruna and his rabbit character Miffy.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 1980, the museum includes the collection of the Van Baaren Museum and since 2006, the museum also runs the Miffy Museum, a museum across the street dedicated to Dick Bruna and his rabbit character Miffy.

facts.text: Utrecht Caravaggisti Gerard van Honthorst and Hendrick ter Brugghen studied Caravaggio in Rome.
facts.sourceQuote: Other highlights are many significant paintings by the Utrecht Caravaggisti, such as Gerard van Honthorst and Hendrick ter Brugghen. Both of them travelled to Rome in the early 17th century to study the works of the Italian master Caravaggio.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Other highlights are many significant paintings by the Utrecht Caravaggisti, such as Gerard van Honthorst and Hendrick ter Brugghen. Both of them travelled to Rome in the early 17th century to study the works of the Italian master Caravaggio.

facts.text: Abraham Bloemaert and Paulus Moreelse were significant Utrecht painters alongside Wtewael.
facts.sourceQuote: In the previous generation, as well as Wtewael, Abraham Bloemaert and the portraitist Paulus Moreelse were the most significant Utrecht painters, with Jan van Scorel still earlier.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the previous generation, as well as Wtewael, Abraham Bloemaert and the portraitist Paulus Moreelse were the most significant Utrecht painters, with Jan van Scorel still earlier.

facts.text: Founders from the Utrechtsch Studenten Corps established the venue in 1972.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater werd in 1972 onder de naam 'Tejater Kikker' opgericht door leden van het Utrechtsch Studenten Corps.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater was founded in 1972 under the name 'Tejater Kikker' by members of the Utrechtsch Studenten Corps.

facts.text: The group initially operated inside the student society Placet hic Requiescere Musis.
facts.sourceQuote: Het was aanvankelijk gehuisvest in de studentensociëteit Placet hic Requiescere Musis van het USC aan het Janskerkhof.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was initially housed in the student society Placet hic Requiescere Musis of the USC at Janskerkhof.

facts.text: By 1980, the renamed theater relocated to a new home on Ganzenmarkt.
facts.sourceQuote: Inmiddels 'Theater Kikker' geheten verhuisde het in 1980 naar de Ganzenmarkt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: By now called 'Theater Kikker', it moved to the Ganzenmarkt in 1980.

facts.text: The venue hosts a mix of contemporary theater and modern dance performances.
facts.sourceQuote: Het theater heeft twee zalen waarin een mengeling aan eigentijds toneel en moderne dans ten uitvoering gebracht wordt.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The theater has two rooms in which a mixture of contemporary theater and modern dance is performed.

facts.text: Cardinal Alfrink inaugurated the church in 1965 after construction finished that year.
facts.sourceQuote: De bouw was voltooid in 1965 waarna de inwijding werd gedaan door kardinaal Alfrink, de toenmalige bisschop van Utrecht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Construction was completed in 1965 after which the inauguration was carried out by Cardinal Alfrink, the then bishop of Utrecht.

facts.text: From 1995 to 2002, the library operated within the Multicultural Emancipation Center on Wittevrouwenkade.
facts.sourceQuote: Van 1995 tot 2002 maakte de Vrouwenbibliotheek deel uit van het Multicultureel Emancipatiecentrum (MEC) aan de Wittevrouwenkade.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: From 1995 to 2002, the Vrouwenbibliotheek was part of the Multicultural Emancipation Center (MEC) on the Wittevrouwenkade.

facts.text: After IDEA dissolved, a private individual named Marjolein Datema took over the entire book collection in 2009.
facts.sourceQuote: Na stopzetting van de subsidies en opheffing van IDEA, werd de boekencollectie in 2009 overgenomen door een particulier, Marjolein Datema.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: After the subsidies were discontinued and IDEA was abolished, the book collection was taken over in 2009 by a private individual, Marjolein Datema.

facts.text: The institution began in 1984 as a meeting place for feminist literature and women's culture documentation.
facts.sourceQuote: De Vrouwenbibliotheek en Documentatiecentrum Utrecht (VDU), in 1984 opgericht, was een plek waar vrouwen in de Nederlandse stad Utrecht en omgeving feministische literatuur konden vinden, documentatiemateriaal en non-fictie over de vrouwencultuur, en waar zij ook een ontmoetingsplaats hadden.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: De Vrouwenbibliotheek and Documentatiecentrum Utrecht (VDU), founded in 1984, was a place where women in the Dutch city of Utrecht and its surroundings could find feminist literature, documentation and non-fiction about women's culture, and where they also had a meeting place.

facts.text: The collection expanded from 200 books to 8,500 by 1992 through rapid growth and donations.
facts.sourceQuote: De collectie groeide snel van ca 200 boeken bij de start naar 8.500 in 1992.. Ook schenkingen van betrokken vrouwen droegen bij aan de groei van de collectie.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The collection grew rapidly from about 200 books at the start to 8,500 in 1992.. Donations from involved women also contributed to the growth of the collection.

facts.text: Men were initially barred but gained access in 1990 after a specific decision was made.
facts.sourceQuote: Over het toelaten van mannen werd gediscussieerd, zeker toen de VDU nog in het Vrouwenhuis zat, waar mannen niet werden toegelaten. In 1990 viel het besluit dat mannen wel in de Vrouwenbibliotheek mochten komen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: There was discussion about allowing men, especially when the VDU was still in the Women's House, where men were not allowed. In 1990, it was decided that men were allowed to come into the Vrouwenbibliotheek.

facts.text: A 1989 move placed the library on the ground floor so the collection became visible from the street.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1989 ging de bibliotheek naar de begane grond waardoor de collectie vanaf de straat zichtbaar werd.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1989 the library moved to the ground floor, making the collection visible from the street.

facts.text: The venue opened in September 2015 as CineMec Utrecht before becoming Pathé Utrecht Leidsche Rijn in May 2018.
facts.sourceQuote: Het gebouw werd geopend op 18 september 2015, toen onder de naam CineMec Utrecht, met de bijnaam "de Sterrenkijker". Sinds 2014 is CineMec onderdeel van Pathé Nederland en sinds mei 2018 draagt de bioscoop de huidige naam.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The building was opened on September 18, 2015, under the name CineMec Utrecht, with the nickname "the Stargazer". Since 2014, CineMec has been part of Pathé Netherlands and since May 2018 the cinema has been called by its current name.

facts.text: The cinema features seven rooms with a total of 1574 seats across the venue.
facts.sourceQuote: De bioscoop heeft zeven zalen (1574 zitplaatsen), waarvan de grootste ruim 284 bezoekers kan herbergen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The cinema has seven rooms (1574 seats), the largest of which can accommodate more than 284 visitors.

facts.text: Since 2017, films have been projected on the roof several times weekly during summer.
facts.sourceQuote: Sinds 2017 wordt in de zomer een aantal keer per week op het dak een film vertoond.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2017, a film has been shown on the roof several times a week in the summer.

facts.text: Construction began in 1891 after a conflict and the death of architect Cornelis Vermeijs.
facts.sourceQuote: Oorspronkelijk was het gedacht als een geschenk aan de Universiteit ter gelegenheid van haar 250-jarig bestaan in 1886, maar door een slepend conflict, en het onverwacht overlijden van een van de architecten, Cornelis Vermeijs, kon de bouw pas in 1891 beginnen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Originally it was intended as a gift to the University on the occasion of its 250th anniversary in 1886, but due to a protracted conflict, and the unexpected death of one of the architects, Cornelis Vermeijs, construction could only begin in 1891.

facts.text: Before this building existed, the university used annexes of the Domkerk starting from its inception.
facts.sourceQuote: De universiteit van Utrecht was vanaf haar ontstaan gevestigd in enkele bijgebouwen van de Domkerk, met name in de kruisgang en de kapittelzaal.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The University of Utrecht was based in several annexes of the Domkerk from its inception, particularly in the transept and the chapter hall.

facts.text: A representative university building on the Domplein became necessary only during the nineteenth century.
facts.sourceQuote: Pas in de negentiende eeuw ontstond behoefte aan een representatief universiteitsgebouw aan het Domplein.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was only in the nineteenth century that there was a need for a representative university building on the Domplein.

facts.text: Around 750 students from 70 different nationalities live and study on campus.
facts.sourceQuote: Around 750 students of 70 different nationalities live and study on campus.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 750 students of 70 different nationalities live and study on campus.

facts.text: Students design individual curricula using courses from over 20 disciplines across three domains.
facts.sourceQuote: Students can design their individual curriculum with courses from more than 20 disciplines in three domains: Science, Social Sciences and Humanities.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Students can design their individual curriculum with courses from more than 20 disciplines in three domains: Science, Social Sciences and Humanities.

facts.text: The Dining Hall building previously served as a military mess at the Kromhout Kazerne barracks.
facts.sourceQuote: The Dining Hall building served as a military mess on the Kromhout Kazerne.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Dining Hall building served as a military mess on the Kromhout Kazerne.

facts.text: The Auditorium building formerly operated as a military museum before becoming a lecture space.
facts.sourceQuote: The Auditorium building used to serve as a military museum, but is now used for larger lectures and performances.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The Auditorium building used to serve as a military museum, but is now used for larger lectures and performances.

facts.text: A cannon was installed in its tower in 1576 to fire at the besieged Vredenburg Castle.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1576-1577 a cannon was installed in the church tower, aimed at Vredenburg Castle where the Spanish soldiers there were under siege by the Utrecht schutters.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1576-1577 a cannon was installed in the church tower, aimed at Vredenburg Castle where the Spanish soldiers there were under siege by the Utrecht schutters.

facts.text: Dutch pilgrims begin their journey to Santiago de Compostela at this specific church.
facts.sourceQuote: Today it is known as the starting place for Dutch pilgrims on their way to Santiago de Compostela along the Way of St. James.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Today it is known as the starting place for Dutch pilgrims on their way to Santiago de Compostela along the Way of St. James.

facts.text: Famous architect Willem Dudok designed the structure in 1937.
facts.sourceQuote: Het is in 1937 door de bekende architect Willem Dudok ontworpen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: It was designed in 1937 by the famous architect Willem Dudok.

facts.text: A gas explosion in 1880 severely damaged the roof, stage, and decorations during a performance.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1880 vond er tijdens een voorstelling een gasexplosie plaats, met grote schade aan het dak, het toneel en de decors tot gevolg.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1880, during a performance, a gas explosion occurred, resulting in significant damage to the roof, the stage and the decorations.

facts.text: Acting couple Jan Eduard de Vries and Maria Francisca Bia owned the theater around 1860.
facts.sourceQuote: Omstreeks 1860 was dit theater eigendom van het acteursechtpaar Jan Eduard de Vries en Maria Francisca Bia.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Around 1860, this theater was owned by the acting couple Jan Eduard de Vries and Maria Francisca Bia.

facts.text: The complex was radically renovated in 1983, with most structures demolished and replaced.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1983 is het complex radicaal verbouwd, het grootste deel werd gesloopt en maakte plaats voor nieuwbouw.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1983, the complex was radically renovated, most of it was demolished and replaced by new buildings.

facts.text: Sisters of Love lived in the monastery until they departed in 2001.
facts.sourceQuote: Later wordt het een klooster voor de Zusters van Liefde. De zusters blijven er tot 2001.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Later it becomes a monastery for the Sisters of Love. The sisters stay there until 2001.

facts.text: Former monastery cells were adapted into 49 separate apartments ranging from 40 to 90 square meters.
facts.sourceQuote: De kloostercellen werden geschikt gemaakt voor afzonderlijke verkoop. Sindsdien is het een appartementencomplex met 49 koopappartementen, met een oppervlakte van 40 tot 90 m².
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The monastery cells were adapted for separate sale. Since then, it has been a residential complex with 49 apartments for sale, with an area of 40 to 90 m².

facts.text: The protected facade, stained glass windows, and large garden remain preserved despite later changes.
facts.sourceQuote: De gevel (beschermd stadsgezicht), de gebrandschilderde ramen en de grote kloostertuin zijn bewaard gebleven.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The facade (protected cityscape), the stained glass windows and the large monastery garden have been preserved.

facts.text: Agnes van Zantwijck was not the only woman to live built-in during Utrecht's 15th century.
facts.sourceQuote: Overigens was Van Zwantwijck niet de enige vrouw die zich in de 15de eeuw in Utrecht in liet metselen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: By the way, Van Zwantwijck was not the only woman who had herself built in Utrecht in the 15th century.

facts.text: The Dutch mathematician Laurens Praalder was buried in the Geertekerk on April 24, 1793.
facts.sourceQuote: Op 24 april 1793 is de Nederlandse wiskundige Laurens Praalder bijgezet in de Geertekerk.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: On April 24, 1793, the Dutch mathematician Laurens Praalder was buried in the Geertekerk.

facts.text: The Geertekerk is dedicated to Saint Gertrude of Nijvel, whose name inspired the church's title.
facts.sourceQuote: In de middeleeuwen was het een van de vier parochiekerken in die stad, en wel de kleinste en de jongste, gewijd aan de heilige Gertrudis van Nijvel.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the Middle Ages, it was one of the four parish churches in that city, and the smallest and youngest, dedicated to the saint Gertrude of Nijvel.

facts.text: In 1855, hundreds of flood victims from Veenendaal were temporarily housed within its walls.
facts.sourceQuote: Als gevolg van een overstroming van de Rijn werden in 1855 honderden inwoners van Veenendaal tijdelijk in de kerk ondergebracht.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: As a result of a flood of the Rhine, hundreds of residents of Veenendaal were temporarily accommodated in the church in 1855.

facts.text: In 2015, the theater changed its name to Theater Utrecht to signal a new direction.
facts.sourceQuote: In januari 2015 veranderde de naam in Theater Utrecht als symbool van de nieuwe koers.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In January 2015, the name was changed to Theater Utrecht as a symbol of the new direction.

facts.text: The project places a separate stone for each individual victim rather than grouping them together.
facts.sourceQuote: Demnig legt voor elk slachtoffer een aparte steen, meestal voor de laatste zelfgekozen woning.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Demnig lays a separate stone for each victim, usually for the last self-chosen home.

facts.text: A 1674 tornado blew a spire off the tower while collapsing the Domkerk nave.
facts.sourceQuote: Een sterke tornado in de zomer van 1674, dat o.a. het middenschip van de Domkerk deed instorten, blies een torenspits van zijn plaats.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A strong tornado in the summer of 1674, which among other things caused the central nave of the Domkerk to collapse, blew a spire off its place.

facts.text: Piet Klaarhamer and Gerrit Rietveld designed several vases for Mobach Keramiek.
facts.sourceQuote: Piet Klaarhamer en Gerrit Rietveld ontwierpen een aantal vazen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Piet Klaarhamer and Gerrit Rietveld designed a number of vases.

facts.text: A museum at the factory site opens to the public only once a year.
facts.sourceQuote: Een deel van de collectie is op die locatie ondergebracht in een museum dat eenmaal per jaar open is.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Part of the collection is housed at that location in a museum that is open once a year.

facts.text: Workers monitored the oven's temperature by watching a melting cone bend through a wall hole.
facts.sourceQuote: Dat bereiken van die temperatuur kon men aflezen via een gat in de ovenmuur waarachter een smeltkegel was geplaatst. Het ombuigen van die kegel gaf aan dat de temperatuur was bereikt waarop men stopte met het stoken van de oven en die liet afkoelen.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: The achievement of that temperature could be read through a hole in the oven wall behind which a melting cone had been placed. The bending of that cone indicated that the temperature had been reached at which the oven was stopped being heated and allowed to cool down.

facts.text: The entire firing and cooling cycle for the ovens took approximately one week to complete.
facts.sourceQuote: Dat stoken en afkoelen duurde ongeveer een week.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: That heating and cooling took about a week.

facts.text: Staff worked around the clock to feed coal into channels and remove ash during the firing process.
facts.sourceQuote: Gedurende het stoken was er 24 uur per dag iemand bezig met het vullen van de stookgangen met steenkool en het afvoeren van de as.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: During the firing, someone was working 24 hours a day to fill the firing channels with coal and discharge the ash.

facts.text: The institution began as a Theological School in 1854 before becoming a college in 1939.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1854, a Theological School (Dutch: Theologische School) was founded by the Christian Reformed Church in the Netherlands, a church resulting from a schism in 1834 from the mainline Reformed Church in the Netherlands (Hervormde Kerk), to provide for education for its ministers. The name was changed to Theological College ("Theologische Hogeschool") in 1939.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1854, a Theological School (Dutch: Theologische School) was founded by the Christian Reformed Church in the Netherlands, a church resulting from a schism in 1834 from the mainline Reformed Church in the Netherlands (Hervormde Kerk), to provide for education for its ministers. The name was changed to Theological College ("Theologische Hogeschool") in 1939.

facts.text: A 1944 schism caused parts of the college to split and form a new institute for Liberated churches.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1944, another schism within the Reformed Churches in the Netherlands occurred, called the Liberation (Dutch: Vrijmaking), which resulted in the Reformed Churches in the Netherlands (Liberated). This new church also had a need for its own ministerial education institute, and so a new Theological College of the Reformed Churches (Liberated) was founded from parts of the Theological College.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1944, another schism within the Reformed Churches in the Netherlands occurred, called the Liberation (Dutch: Vrijmaking), which resulted in the Reformed Churches in the Netherlands (Liberated). This new church also had a need for its own ministerial education institute, and so a new Theological College of the Reformed Churches (Liberated) was founded from parts of the Theological College.

facts.text: Notable past faculty included systematic theologians Herman Bavinck and Klaas Schilder.
facts.sourceQuote: Notable faculty of the seminary in the past include systematic theologians Herman Bavinck (1854–1921) and Klaas Schilder (1890–1952), and more recently the New Testament scholar Jakob van Bruggen (born 1936).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Notable faculty of the seminary in the past include systematic theologians Herman Bavinck (1854–1921) and Klaas Schilder (1890–1952), and more recently the New Testament scholar Jakob van Bruggen (born 1936).

facts.text: Both predecessor colleges officially became universities following a 1986 Dutch system change.
facts.sourceQuote: In 1986, both colleges became universities when a change in the Dutch university/polytechnic system was carried out.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In 1986, both colleges became universities when a change in the Dutch university/polytechnic system was carried out.

facts.text: Ordination requires a six-year training path combining a Bachelor of Theology and a Master of Divinity degree.
facts.sourceQuote: In order to be an ordained minister in the Reformed Churches a six-year training including a Bachelor of Theology (BA) and Master of Divinity (MA) are required.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In order to be an ordained minister in the Reformed Churches a six-year training including a Bachelor of Theology (BA) and Master of Divinity (MA) are required.

facts.text: A full English Master of Intercultural Reformed Theology program launched in 2015 to attract international students.
facts.sourceQuote: Since 2015 the university also offers a full English programme: Master of Intercultural Reformed Theology, which attracts International and Dutch students.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Since 2015 the university also offers a full English programme: Master of Intercultural Reformed Theology, which attracts International and Dutch students.

facts.text: Railway equipment conservation began in the 1930s.
facts.sourceQuote: In the 1930s the first steps were taken to conserve old historically significant rail equipment.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: In the 1930s the first steps were taken to conserve old historically significant rail equipment.

facts.text: World War II caused the loss of part of this early collection.
facts.sourceQuote: A portion of this collection was lost during World War II.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: A portion of this collection was lost during World War II.

facts.text: A closed station from 1939 was remodeled to house the collection starting in 1954.
facts.sourceQuote: Maliebaan station, which had been closed in 1939, was found to be a suitable site. The building was remodeled, and in 1954 the museum reopened there.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Maliebaan station, which had been closed in 1939, was found to be a suitable site. The building was remodeled, and in 1954 the museum reopened there.

facts.text: Until 2003, historic steam locomotives lined track one as a distinctive exhibit feature.
facts.sourceQuote: Until 2003, a long line of historic steam locomotives on track one of the station was one of the most distinctive aspects of the exhibit.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Until 2003, a long line of historic steam locomotives on track one of the station was one of the most distinctive aspects of the exhibit.

facts.text: Construction started in 1039, and the church was inaugurated on May 1, 1048.
facts.sourceQuote: Its construction began in 1039 and it was inaugurated on 1 May 1048 by Bernold, Bishop of Utrecht (although the lost west towers were probably only finished about a century after the inauguration).
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Its construction began in 1039 and it was inaugurated on 1 May 1048 by Bernold, Bishop of Utrecht (although the lost west towers were probably only finished about a century after the inauguration).

facts.text: Large nave pillars are hewn from single pieces of red sandstone.
facts.sourceQuote: Characteristic of the Romanesque style in which it is built are the church's large nave pillars, each hewn from one piece of red sandstone, and the crypt under the choir.
facts.sourceQuoteEnglish: Characteristic of the Romanesque style in which it is built are the church's large nave pillars, each hewn from one piece of red sandstone, and the crypt under the choir.

facts.text: The lost west towers were likely finished about a century after the inauguration.
